subject: Sterling Health — demo options while vendor intake completes
messages:

Cc:

Subject: Sterling Health — demo options while vendor intake completes

Hi Sarah — great to meet you last week (intro from Jason). We’re excited to show a short walkthrough of Redwood Inference and how it can help Sterling Health reduce latency for clinical workflows.

Quick availability: I have 30–45 minute slots on Tue 6/20 and Wed 6/21 in the afternoon PT. I know you mentioned procurement and some onboarding items; if vendor intake is still blocking a live session, we can: 
- Record a short guided demo (15–20 mins) and share a time-stamped index for the team to review asynchronously
- Provide a temporary sandbox and a checklist so your procurement team can exercise the vendor questionnaire early

Attached: NDA_Redwood_v1.pdf (draft) — happy to route to legal for review.

Would you prefer a recorded-first approach while your intake completes, or should we hold a live slot and move it if procurement needs more time?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: NDA_Redwood_v1.pdf (pdf, 86 KB)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@sterlinghealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jason Wu <jwu@sterlinghealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@sterlinghealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Sterling Health — demo options while vendor intake completes

Thanks Marissa — great to connect. Quick update from our side on blockers: 
- Procurement requires a signed NDA + completion of our vendor intake questionnaire before any system access (includes a security review). I’ve attached the questionnaire request so you can see the scope.
- Our CIO + a couple of stakeholders are traveling the week of 6/24; that means a live exec demo is unlikely until early July.

Given that, a recorded walkthrough would be perfect. Could you: 
1) Circulate a DocuSign link for the NDA (we prefer executed copy before sandbox creds)
2) Share the vendor questionnaire so our procurement lead can triage internally (I’m copying Procurement)
3) If possible, provide a short checklist that maps your SOC2 and network controls to our form — that speeds review.

Happy for a follow-up live Q&A once the intake ticket is cleared.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Sr. PM, Digital Transformation — Sterling Health
sarah.liu@sterlinghealth.com

Attachment: Sterling_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 23 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@sterlinghealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-18T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Sterling Health — demo options while vendor intake completes

Sarah — thanks for the clarity and for looping procurement. Priyom (SE) and Aditya (my manager) are on copy to help with the technical packet and legal redlines. Proposed plan: 

1) Marissa: I’ll send the NDA via DocuSign today and include a short note highlighting any standard commercial language we expect to hold. (Attachment: NDA_Redwood_v1.pdf)
2) Priyom: can you map our SOC2 summary + network controls to Sterling’s questionnaire and drop a one-page mapping? That will help Procurement triage.
3) We’ll record a 20-minute guided demo (walkthrough + live examples) and provide a time-stamped index and short FAQ for asynchronous review. Post-recording we’ll offer a 30-minute live Q&A (optional) once procurement clears the intake.

Dates: we can deliver the recording within 48 hours after the NDA is executed. Live Q&A options: week of 7/8, or first available date after your execs are back.

Action items now:
- I’ll route the NDA to DocuSign (Marissa)
- Priyom to prepare SOC2 mapping and demo script
- Procurement to open an intake ticket and advise on any non-standard contract clauses

Sound OK?

—Marissa

Attachment: NDA_Redwood_v1.pdf (pdf, draft)

From: Jason Wu <jwu@sterlinghealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>

Marissa / Priyom — procurement opened ticket #INT-2419 and we’ve attached the questionnaire to that record. Expected timeline is ~7–10 business days for the intake review (resource permitting). A couple notes from legal: 
- We received your NDA PDF; we’ll push via DocuSign but our legal team flagged Section 6 (indemnity) for redline. I’ve attached a marked copy (please confirm whether Redwood has standard language we can use).
- Please add a SOC2 summary or your security pack to the intake record — that will prevent follow-ups.

If you can send the recording and the SOC2 summary now, Procurement will start an informal triage in parallel (helps speed the formal review).

Thanks,
Jason Wu
Senior Procurement Manager — Sterling Health
procurement@sterlinghealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>

Jason / team — thanks for the ticket number and the flagged section. Quick responses and next steps from Redwood: 

- We can accept redlines on Section 6 as long as changes are mutual; I’ll have Legal confirm the exact wording and share a DocuSign envelope by end of day.
- Attached is our SOC2_summary.pdf and a one-page mapping to the questionnaire (SOC2_summary.pdf). I’ll also upload both to the intake ticket.
- We’ll record a 20-minute guided demo today and share a link + time-stamped index within 48 hours. That recording will intentionally avoid any privileged customer data and use synthetic examples.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: send DocuSign NDA to Sterling (today)
- Priyom: upload SOC2_summary.pdf and mapping to INT-2419 (today)
- Jason/Procurement: confirm receipt and estimate formal clearance date
- Sterling execs: review recording and advise if a live Q&A is desired in week of 7/8

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward asynchronously so stakeholders can keep momentum while procurement runs its course.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
